BURSEVI:v6p289/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r1.claim: Shuayb offers Moses one of his two daughters in marriage; the woman is identified as Safuriyya, the one linked with the fire episode.
BURSEVI:v6p289/r1.anchor: {إحدى ابنتى هاتين} (يكي را ازين دو دختران)

BURSEVI:v6p289/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r2.claim: The phrase أن تأجرني describes Moses becoming Shuayb's hired worker; the eight حجج are eight years.
BURSEVI:v6p289/r2.anchor: حال كونك مشروطا عليك أو واجبا أن تكون لي أجيرا

BURSEVI:v6p289/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r3.claim: The eight-year work is a condition owed to the father, not a dowry, since the wording says تأجرني rather than تأجرها; a marriage contract with a known work term for the guardian was permitted in Shuayb's law.

BURSEVI:v6p289/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r4.claim: A view reported in Ayn al-Maani says earlier laws let fathers receive their daughters' dowries, a rule abrogated in Islam by the command to give women their dowries.
BURSEVI:v6p289/r4.anchor: در شرائع متقدمه مهر اختران مر دررا بوده

BURSEVI:v6p289/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r5.claim: In Islamic law a dowry must be valuable property and delivered to the woman; the author cites the commands to seek with wealth and to give women their dowries.

BURSEVI:v6p289/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r6.claim: If a free man marries for Quran teaching or a year's service, the marriage is valid but the proper equivalent dowry is due because teaching or free labor is not property; a slave's service can count because his person is delivered.
BURSEVI:v6p289/r6.anchor: فلو تزوجها على تعليم القرآن أو خدمته لها سنة يصح النكاح

BURSEVI:v6p289/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r7.claim: On either reading—dowry or condition—the verse concerns Shuayb's law; in current law the dowry belongs to the woman, and Abu Hanifa disallows a condition that draws the dowry's benefit to the father, unlike al-Shafii.
BURSEVI:v6p289/r7.anchor: فالآية سواء حملت على الصداق أو على الشرط فناظرة إلى شريعة شعيب

BURSEVI:v6p289/r8.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289/r8.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289/r8.claim: Some say the account simply states what Shuayb and Moses intended and agreed to do, without ruling on the legal basis of either arrangement in their law.
BURSEVI:v6p289/r8.anchor: ما حكي عنهما بيان لما عزما عليه واتفقا

BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r1.claim: God inspired Moses in a dream to strike the watering-place with his staff; the sheep then bore the specified lambs, showing Shuayb that this was provision from God for Moses and his wife, so he fulfilled the agreement and handed over the flock.
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r1.anchor: فأوحى الله إليه في المنام أن اضرب بعصاك الماء الذي هو في مستقى الأغنام

BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r2.speaker: أبو الليث
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r2.claim: Such a condition is not binding in Islamic law, but a prophet's promise is binding, so Moses fulfilled his promise.
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r2.anchor: قال أبو الليث : مثل هذا الشرط في شريعتنا

BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p290#2/r3.claim: The cited Mathnawi verse teaches that fidelity is a companion whose good or evil follows one into the grave.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r1.claim: The Madyan episode displays virtues that prepared Moses for revelation: generosity, helping the distressed, compassion, modesty, gratitude, chastity, and fidelity; Shuaib likewise shows hospitality, protection of the fearful, and gentleness.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r1.anchor: هو ما تضمنته من فضائل الأعمال ومناقب أهل الكمال

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r2.claim: These character traits could lead Meccan polytheists to compare Moses with Muhammad's known virtue before his mission and recognize the signs of revelation; Muslims should also emulate prophetic character.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p110/r2.anchor: ليعتبر المشركون بذلك إن كان لهم اعتبار في مقايسة تلك الأحوال بأجناسها من أحوال النبي

JISHUMI:v8p5488/r1.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r1.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r1.claim: Ijārah is a contract exchanging use or services for compensation, and is permissible in Islamic law as it was in the earlier community's law.
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r1.anchor: وهي عقد على منافع بعوض، وهو جائز في شريعتنا، كما جاز في شريعتهم

JISHUMI:v8p5488/r4.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r4.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r4.claim: Nikāḥ is used for intercourse and for the marriage contract; the sounder legal view is that it literally denotes the contract, possibly through transfer from its figurative linguistic use.
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r4.anchor: والأصح أنه في عرف الشرع حقيقة للعقد

JISHUMI:v8p5488/r5.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r5.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v8p5488/r5.claim: A ḥujjah is a year, and ajal means a span or appointed time.

QURTUBI-FULL:2:283#12/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:2:283#12/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:2:283#12/r2.claim: Desire for increase is natural: Sa'd ibn Ubada prayed for abundance, Joseph's brothers sought an extra camel-load, Shu'ayb offered Moses ten years, and Job gathered golden locusts.

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r3.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r3.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r3.claim: Shuaib wants Moses as a son-in-law because of his strength and trust, detachment from worldly life, reliance on God, and flight from unbelievers.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r3.anchor: رغب شعيب في مصاهرته، لما وصفته به

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r4.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r4.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r4.claim: Warsh and Ahmad ibn Musa, transmitting from Abu Amr, omit the hamza in أنكحك إحدى.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r4.anchor: وقرأ ورش، وأحمد بن موسى، عن أبي عمرو: أنكحك احدى، بحذف الهمزة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r5.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r5.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r5.claim: The apparent wording gives the wali a role in contracting marriage, unlike Abu Hanifa's allowance in some cases for an adult competent woman to contract her own marriage.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r5.anchor: وظاهر قوله: أن أنكحك، أن الإنكاح إلى الولي

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r6.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r6.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r6.claim: The verse supports a wali offering his ward to a prospective husband, as Umar did; Malik and al-Shafiʿi allow a father to marry his virgin daughter without consultation, while Abu Hanifa requires her consent once adult.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r6.anchor: وفيه دليل على عرض الولي وليته على الزوج

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r7.claim: Some infer that a marriage is valid only with the terms nikah or tazwij; Rabiʿa, al-Shafiʿi, Abu Thawr, Abu Ubayd, and Dawud hold that view.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r7.anchor: وفيه دليل على قول من قال: لا ينعقد إلا بلفظ التزويج

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r8.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r8.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r8.claim: Offering one of the two unnamed daughters is a proposal, not a contract, because Shuaib says he intends to marry; the bride must be identified at contract, and the hire's start term is not yet fixed.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r8.anchor: وإحدى ابنتي: مبهم، وهذا عرض لا عقد

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r9.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r9.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r9.claim: The verse apparently permits marriage in exchange for service; al-Shafiʿi and his companions and Ibn Habib accept this, while al-Zamakhshari's inference that Shuaib had other daughters from هاتين is rejected because it points to the two women just seen.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r9.anchor: والظاهر من الآية جواز النكاح بالإجارة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r10.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r10.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r10.claim: على أن تأجرني is circumstantial from the agent or object in أنكحك; تأجرني means you work for me, its second object is omitted, and حجج may be an adverb or an object meaning eight years of tending.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p299/r10.anchor: على أن تأجرني في موضع الحال من ضمير أنكحك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r1.claim: The second object of تأجرني is omitted and understood as yourself; eight حجج can be a temporal adverb or, as al-Zamakhshari says, the object denoting eight years of herding.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r1.anchor: ومفعول تأجرني الثاني محذوف تقديره نفسك

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r2.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r2.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r2.claim: Completing ten years is an unrequired gift; Shuaib promises not to burden Moses with either the longer term, intrusive oversight, or tasks outside the agreement, and promises fair or generally righteous treatment if God wills.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v8p300/r2.anchor: فإن أتممت عشرا فمن عندك: أي هو تبرع وتفضل لا اشتراط

AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r2.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r2.speaker: author
AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r2.claim: One Arabic form is أجر غلامي، فهو مأجور and أجرته، فهو مؤجر, on the أَفْعَلْتُه/مُفْعَل pattern.
AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r2.anchor: وقال {تأجرني} في لغة العرب منهم من يقول "أجر غلامي" ف"هو مأجور" و"أجرته" ف"هو مؤجر" يريد: أفعلته" ف"هو مفعل"

AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r3.author: al-Akhfash al-Awsaṭ
AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r3.speaker: بعضهم
AKHFASH:v2p469#2/r3.claim: Some instead say آجرته فهو مؤاجر, on the فاعلته pattern.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p198#3/r10.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p198#3/r10.speaker: الحسن وعطاء وعكرمة
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p198#3/r10.claim: Hasan, Ata, and Ikrima hold that all of al-Qasas is Meccan.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p198#3/r10.anchor: وروي عن الحسن وعطاء وعكرمة أنها مكية كلها

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.claim: In exclamations such as ويحه رجلا, ولله دره رجلا and حسبك به رجلا, من may be added for emphasis; رجل is accusative, governed by the first construction and outside its initial wording.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.anchor: وانتصب الرجل لأنه ليس من الكلام الأول وعمل فيه

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.claim: ويحه expresses admiration without specifying its aspect; adding فارسا or حافظا identifies the quality being praised.
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.anchor: فارسا وحافظا فقد اختصصت ولم تبهم

SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:وذلكقولكويحهرجلاوللهدرهرجلاوحسب.claim: عباس بن مرداس's أبرحت فارسا means roughly كفى بك فارسا; the bāʾ reinforces the construction. Al-Aʿshā's أبرحت ربا وأبرحت جارا and أكرم به رجلا are parallel.

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.claim: In nisba formation from a name of at least four letters ending in yāʾ after kasra, the old yāʾ is deleted before the suffixal yāʾ, avoiding two adjacent sukūns; examples include ناجي, أدلي, صحاري and ثماني.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.anchor: فإذا كان الاسم في هذه الصفة أذهبت الياء

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.claim: Forms such as يماني and بخاتي reflect deletion of the two yāʾs introduced by nisba; يرمي remains يرمي, while عرقوة yields عرقي.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.anchor: رجل اسمه بخاتي لقلت هذا بخاتي كما ترى

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.speaker: الخليل
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.claim: Al-Khalīl says a dialect that opens the preceding kasra in يثربي or تغلبي is altering the form; by the same pattern, يرمي would yield يرموي. The poet's الحانوي contrasts with expected الحاني.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.anchor: وقال الخليل من قال في يثرب

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.speaker: الخليل
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.claim: Al-Khalīl treats فتح in تغلبي as optional alteration like سهلي and بصري, not a required nisba rule; otherwise forms such as يشكري and جلهمي would be expected. Yūnus agrees.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابالإضافةإلىكلاسمكانعلىأرب.anchor: وقال الخليل الذين قالوا تغلبي ففتحوا مغيرين

SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r1.speaker: أبو عمرو
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r1.claim: Abu Amr is reported to omit hamza from إحدى, reading حدى, like Ibn Muhaysin's حداها in 28:25.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r1.anchor: قوله: { أن أنكحك إحدى }: روي عن أبي عمرو: " أنكحك حدى " بحذف همزة " إحدى " ، وهذه تشبه قراءة ابن محيصن

SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r2.claim: على أن تأجرني is a circumstantial clause, attached either to the father imposing the condition or to Moses accepting it.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r2.anchor: قوله: { على أن تأجرني } في محل نصب على الحال: إما من الفاعل أو من المفعول أي: مشروطا على، أو عليك ذلك.

SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r3.claim: On the hired-worker sense, تأجرني means being my employee, with yourself omitted as second object; ثماني حجج is a time adverbial.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r3.anchor: مضارع أجرته: كنت له أجيرا. ومفعوله الثاني محذوف أي: تأجرني نفسك. و " ثماني حجج " ظرف له.

SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r4.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhshari also allows آجرته to mean granting compensation; then ثماني حجج is an object meaning care for eight seasons, since labor, not time itself, earns reward.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r4.anchor: أو من آجرته [كذا]: إذا أثبته [إياه]. ومنه تعزية/ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: " آجركم الله ورحمكم " و " ثماني حجج " مفعول به.

SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r5.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r5.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r5.claim: The author corrects the Shaykh's report: ثماني حجج is an object only on the compensation sense, and must mean work done during that time.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27/r5.anchor: قلت: الزمخشري لم يجعلها مفعولا ثانيا على هذا الوجه، وإنما جعلها مفعولا ثانيا على وجه آخر.

SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r1.claim: فمن عندك may be a predicate of omitted فهي, or an accusative phrase with an implied verb meaning you added or freely gave it.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r1.anchor: قوله: { فمن عندك } يجوز أن يكون في محل رفع خبرا لمبتدأ محذوف، تقديره: فهي من عندك، أو نصب أي: فقد زدتها

SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r2.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r2.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r2.claim: أن أشق is governed as the object of أريد.

SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r3.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r3.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r3.claim: شق عليه is an elegant metaphor: it splits someone's judgment between being able and unable to bear something.
SAMIN-DURR:28:27#2/r3.anchor: وحقيقة قولهم " شق عليه " أي: شق ظنه نصفين، فتارة يقول: أطيق، وتارة: لا أطيق. وهو من أحسن مجاز.

ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r1.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r1.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r1.claim: أنكحك means “I will marry you to” one of my daughters.

ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r2.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r2.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r2.claim: The agreement requires Moses to work as a hired man for eight years.
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r2.anchor: أي تكون أجيرا لي ثماني سنين.

ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r3.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r3.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r3.claim: Completing ten years is voluntary generosity, not an obligation.
ZAJJAJ:v4p141/r3.anchor: أي فذلك بفضل - منك ليس بواجب عليك.

ASAD-NOTES:28:27#n22/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:28:27#n22/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:28:27#n22/r1.claim: The literal wording is "one of the righteous".

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r1.claim: Twenty-six Itqān questions have parallels in al-Waqf wa-l-ibtidāʾ, but Bint al-Shāṭiʾ says their dependence on that book cannot be established because other sources are possible.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r1.anchor: مما له نظير في (الوقف والابتداء) ست وعشرون مسألة، لا نملك الجزم بأنها المنقولة منه

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r2.claim: Eighteen Itqān questions also resemble entries in al-Ṭabarānī's al-Muʿjam al-kabīr, but that parallel likewise does not prove the source of transmission.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r2.anchor: ويقال مثل ذلك في ثماني عشرة مسألة بالإتقان، لها نظائرى في المعجم الكبير للطبراني

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r3.speaker: محمد فؤاد عبد الباقي
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās's answers occur across tafsīr and works on Qur'anic rarities; Muḥammad Fuʾād ʿAbd al-Bāqī compiled the Itqān material alphabetically.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r3.anchor: خادم القرآن والسنة "الأستاذ محمد فؤاد عبد الباقي"

BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r4.speaker: أبو بكر الأنباري
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r4.claim: Later writers often follow al-Anbārī's argument for using poetry to establish Qur'anic Arabic usage; al-Zarkashī, al-Suyūṭī, and al-Salāwī transmit this discussion.
BINTSHATI-IJAZ:p296/r4.anchor: وغالباً ما يئول المتأخرون في ذلك إلى "أبي بكر الأنباري" فيما قاله

QIRAAT-ER:28:27:4#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:4#1/r1.speaker: hmz
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:4#1/r1.claim: The segment identifies the standard Ḥafṣ form, with hamzat al-waṣl elided.
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:4#1/r1.anchor: hmz, mutawatir: standard ḥafṣ with hamzat al-waṣl elision

QIRAAT-ER:28:27:5#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:5#1/r1.speaker: hmz
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:5#1/r1.claim: In the standard reading, an fuses with the following waṣl and the nūn carries ḍamma.
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:5#1/r1.anchor: hmz, mutawatir: standard reading: an fuses with following waṣl; vowel u on nūn

QIRAAT-ER:28:27:6#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:6#1/r1.speaker: hmz
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:6#1/r1.claim: The standard reading pronounces the hamza of iḥdā after nkiḥaka.
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:6#1/r1.anchor: hmz, mutawatir: standard: hamza on iḥdā pronounced after nkiḥaka

QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#1/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#1/r1.speaker: Gm
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#1/r1.claim: The standard form of hātayni has a single nūn.
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#1/r1.anchor: Gm, mutawatir: standard with single nūn

QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#2/r1.author: QIRAAT-ER
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#2/r1.speaker: Gm
QIRAAT-ER:28:27:8#2/r1.claim: The variant form doubles the nūn in hātaynni.

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r1.claim: The father’s statement is an explanatory resumption answering what he said after hearing his daughter; its emphatic form conveys strong desire for the proposal.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r1.anchor: استئناف بياني كأنه قيل : فما قال أبوها بعد أن سمع كلامها فقيل : قال إني

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r2.claim: The demonstrative hint may imply he had other daughters; al-Mundhir reports four younger sisters, while al-Biqāʿī says seven as in the Torah and al-Kashshāf sees evidence for that.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r2.anchor: وفي قوله ( هاتين ) إيماء إلى أنه كانت له بنات أخر غيرهما وقد أخرج ابن المنذر

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r3.claim: The objection that the demonstrative proves other daughters is not decisive: pointing could distinguish these two from other known daughters; al-Ālūsī says the dispute is not worth pressing.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r3.anchor: واعترض بأنه لا دلالة فيه على ما ذكر إذ يكفي في الحاجة إلى الاشارة

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r4.speaker: ورش وأحمد بن موسى عن أبي عمرو
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r4.claim: Warsh and Aḥmad ibn Mūsā from Abū ʿAmr read the verb with the hamza omitted.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r4.anchor: أحمد بن موسى عن أبي عمرو

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r5.claim: The condition that Moses work for him can be circumstantial to the object of the marriage verb, meaning the marriage is conditional on it, or circumstantial to its subject, as Abū al-Baqāʾ says.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r5.anchor: في موضع الحال من مفعول ( أنكحك ) أي مشروطا عليه

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r6.claim: Taʾjurnī can mean that Moses hires himself out to the father, with thamanī ḥijaj specifying the period; the verb then takes one object.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r6.anchor: وتأجرني من أجرته كنت له أجيرا كقولك أبوته كنت له أبا

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r7.claim: Alternatively, taʾjurnī can mean reward me, from God's rewarding someone: it takes two objects, with an omitted noun meaning tending the sheep for eight years as the marriage payment.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r7.anchor: ويجوز أن يكون تأجرني بمعنى تثيبني من أجره تعالى على ما فعل

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r8.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r8.claim: On the reward sense, the phrase may modify the verb after an omitted object: Moses compensates the father with his service or labor over eight years.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r8.anchor: وجوز على هذا المعنى أن يكون ظرفا لتأجرني أيضا بحذف المفعول

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r9.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r9.speaker: المبرد
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r9.claim: Al-Mubarrad distinguishes ajartu without lengthening from ājartu with lengthening, says the short form is more common, and on that analysis a second object is omitted: Moses's self.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r9.anchor: ونقل عن المبرد أنه يقال : أجرت داري ومملوكي غير مدود وآجرت ممدودا

ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r10.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r10.speaker: الراغب
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r10.claim: Al-Rāghib says ajara views the act from one party's perspective and ājara from both parties'; both return to the same meaning, and the lexicons list both forms.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p67/r10.anchor: الراغب : يقال أجرت زيدا إذا اعتبر فعل أحدهما

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r1.speaker: تحفة المحتاج
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r1.claim: Tuḥfat al-Muḥtāj gives the forms for hiring and says ijāra, the noun for the wage, is most eloquent with kasra on its hamza before becoming the conventional term for the contract; ḥijaj means years.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r1.anchor: وفيها أن الاجارة بتثليث الهمزة والكسر أفصح لغة اسم للاجرة ثم اشتهرت في العقد

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r2.claim: Ḥijaj is the plural of ḥijja, meaning a year.

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r3.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r3.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r3.claim: If Moses completes ten years of service, the extra two are a voluntary favor from him, not an obligation imposed by the father.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r3.anchor: فمن عندك أي فهو من عندك من طريق التفضل لا من عندي بطريق الالزام

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r4.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r4.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r4.claim: The father does not intend to burden Moses by requiring all ten years, closely policing the schedule, or demanding exhaustive completion of every task.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r4.anchor: بالزام إتمام العشر والمناقشة في مراعاة الأوقات واستيفاء الأعمال

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r5.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r5.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r5.claim: The noun for hardship derives from splitting something into two: what is hard divides the mind over whether to bear it.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r5.anchor: واشتقاق المشقة وهي ما يصعب تحمله من الشق بفتح الشين وهو فصل الشيء

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r6.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r6.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r6.claim: Being among the صالحين means treating Moses well, showing gentleness, and keeping the agreement.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r6.anchor: في حسن المعاملة ولين الجانب والوفاء بالعهد

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r7.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r7.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r7.claim: The father invokes God's will for blessing and entrusts the matter to divine enabling; he is not making his righteousness conditional on permission to act unrighteously.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r7.anchor: ومراد شعيب عليه السلام بالاستثناء التبرك به وتفويض أمره إلى توفيقه تعالى

ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r8.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r8.speaker: بعضهم
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r8.claim: Another explanation is that the father's established righteousness makes a conditional statement unnecessary; al-Ālūsī compares al-Shāfiʿī's statement, I am a believer, God willing.
ALUSI-FULL:v20p68/r8.anchor: قول الشافعي : أنا مؤمن إن شاء الله تعالى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r4.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r4.speaker: شعيب الجبائي
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r4.claim: Shuʿayb al-Jubbaʾi names the daughters Safura and Leya.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r4.anchor: واسمها "صفورة" و"ليا" في قول شعيب الجبائي

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r5.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r5.speaker: ابن إسحاق
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r5.claim: Ibn Ishaq names them Safura and Sharqa.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r6.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r6.speaker: غيرهما
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r6.claim: Others call the elder daughter Saffra and the younger Sufayra.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r7.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r7.speaker: أكثرهم
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r7.claim: Some say Moses married the elder; most say he married the younger, Safura, who had gone to summon him.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r7.anchor: وقيل زوجه الكبرى. وذهب أكثرهم إلى أنه زوجه الصغرى منهما واسمها "صفورة"

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r8.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r8.claim: The condition means Moses would work for the father as a hired shepherd for eight years.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r8.anchor: يعني: أن تكون أجيرا لي ثمان سنين

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r9.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r9.speaker: الفراء
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r9.claim: Al-Farraʾ glosses the bargain as making the reward for marrying his daughter eight years of tending his sheep; Arabs use ajaraka for rewarding.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r9.anchor: قال الفراء: يعني: تجعل ثوابي من تزويجها أن ترعى غنمي

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r10.claim: Hujaj means years, and its singular is hijja.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.claim: Completing ten years would be voluntary generosity, not an obligation.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r11.anchor: أي: إن أتممت عشر سنين فذلك تفضل منك وتبرع، ليس بواجب عليك

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.claim: The father did not intend to require the full ten years unless Moses chose to give the extra time voluntarily.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r12.anchor: أي: ألزمك تمام العشر إلا أن تتبرع

BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.speaker: عمر
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.claim: ʿUmar explains صالحين as being a good companion and keeping the promise.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v6p202#2/r13.anchor: قال عمر: يعني: في حسن الصحبة والوفاء بما قلت

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r6.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r6.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r6.claim: An ujūrani means Moses hire himself to the father or work as his employee, or give back some of what God rewards him.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r6.anchor: أي تأجر نفسك مني أو تكون لي أجيرا

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r7.claim: Eight seasons is an adverbial duration on the first two readings, but an object on the third with sheep-tending understood.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r7.anchor: ظرف على الأولين ومفعول به على الثالث

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r8.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r8.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r8.claim: Completing ten years would be Moses' voluntary generosity, not an obligation imposed by the father.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r8.anchor: فمن عندك } فإتمامه من عندك تفضلا لا من عندي

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r9.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r9.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r9.claim: This is a request to make a marriage contract, not the contract itself; possible explanations include separate wage and dowry, an optional extension, the sheep belonging to the bride, or differing laws.

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r10.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r10.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r10.claim: The father would not burden Moses with an obligatory tenth year or strict scrutiny of schedules and completed work.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r10.anchor: بإلزام إتمام العشر أو المناقشة في مراعاة الأوقات

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r11.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r11.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r11.claim: The root of hardship is splitting: what is difficult seems to split belief in one's capacity and judgment about undertaking it.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r11.anchor: واشتقاق المشقة من الشق فإن ما يصعب عليك

BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r12.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r12.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r12.claim: He promises good treatment, gentleness, and faithful fulfillment of the agreement.
BAYDAWI-FULL:28:25-27/r12.anchor: في حسن المعاملة ولين الجانب والوفاء بالمعاهدة

BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r1.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r1.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r1.claim: Abd al-Salam al-Kannuni, a lecturer at the College of Fundamentals of Religion in Tetouan, completed with the author research on the Qur'anic school in Morocco and a critical study of Yahya ibn Sallam's abridged tafsir.
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r1.anchor: الأستاذ عبد السلام الكنونى » الأستاذ المحاضر بكلية أصول الدين

BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r2.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r2.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r2.claim: Abd al-Kabir al-Madghari, a lecturer at the Faculty of Sharia in Fez, completed a doctoral edition and study with the author on a work about abrogation by Qadi Abu Bakr Ibn al-Arabi.
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r2.anchor: الأستاذ عبد الكبير المدغرى . الأستاذ المحاضر بكلية الشريعة بفاس

BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r3.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r3.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r3.claim: Muhammad al-Rawandi, an assistant professor at Dar al-Hadith al-Hasaniyya, researched Companion poets with the author; the work corrected prior scholarship and counted roughly four hundred Companion poets.
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r3.anchor: الأستاذ محمد الراوندى » الأستاذ المساعد بدار الحديث الحسنية

BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r4.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r4.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r4.claim: The author's daughter Suhayr Muhammad Khalifa, a teacher at al-Azhar, earned an excellent master's degree for a study of Qur'anic citations in Sibawayh's Book.
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r4.anchor: ابنتى «سهير محمد . خليقة » المدرسة بالأزهر » فى رسالتيها

BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r5.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r5.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r5.claim: Suhayr earned a doctorate with first honors for studying Qur'anic citations in Ibn Hisham's Mughni al-Labib; the defense committee recommended publication at al-Azhar's expense.
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r5.anchor: الشواهد القرآنية » فى كتاب مغنى اللبيب لابن هشام

BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r6.author: ʿĀʾisha ʿAbd al-Raḥmān (Bint al-Shāṭiʾ)
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r6.speaker: author
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r6.claim: The author closes by praising and thanking God and quotes Fatir 35:10.
BINTSHATI:v1pdf12/r6.anchor: إليه يصعد الكلم الطيب والعمل الصالح يرفعه

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r6.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r6.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r6.claim: The father is Shuaib, whom Biqaʿi says the Torah calls Reuel and Yithro, and he supplies pronunciations for both names.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r6.anchor: اي شعيب عليه الصلاة والسلام , وهو في التوراة يسمى

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r7.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r7.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r7.claim: The father emphasizes his wish because a stranger is rarely welcomed eagerly on arrival, especially by a leader.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r7.anchor: والتأكيد لأجل أن الغريب قل ما يرغب فيه أول ما يقدم

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r8.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r8.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r8.claim: Ankaḥaka means he will marry Moses to one of his daughters, with the marital bond likened to the joining of the two jaws.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r8.anchor: أي أزوجك زواجا , تكون وصلته كوصلة أحد الحنكين

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r9.claim: These are the two daughters Moses watered; the father lets him consider both and choose one.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r9.anchor: اي الحاضرتين اللتين سقيت لهما , ليتأملهما

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r10.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r10.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r10.claim: The condition can mean either Moses becomes the father’s hired worker or the father sets his own wage or reward at this amount.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r10.anchor: أي تجعل نفسك أجيرا عندي أو تجعل أجري على ذلك

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r11.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r11.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r11.claim: Ḥijaj is the plural of ḥijja, meaning years; Moses would tend sheep and perform other tasks.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r11.anchor: جمع حجة - بالكسر , أي سنين , أي العمل فيها

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r12.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r12.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r12.claim: Ājarahu and ajarahu can refer to hiring or wages; ājarahu can also mean paying the workers their wages.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r12.anchor: وآجره - بالمد والقصر , نم الأجر والإيجار

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r13.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r13.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r13.claim: Eight years are required and completing ten is voluntary; Biqaʿi links these terms to childhood discernment and puberty and the chance to observe a grandson’s character.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r13.anchor: وكان التعيين الثماني لأنها - إذا أسقطت منها مدة احمل - أقل سن

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r14.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r14.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r14.claim: Calling the years ḥijaj is auspicious: they may be blessed through obedience and provision, or each may include pilgrimage to the Sacred House.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r14.anchor: والتعبير بما هو من الحج الذي هو القصد تفاؤلا

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r15.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r15.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r15.claim: The father does not intend hardship in any part of the agreement, obligatory or voluntary.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r15.anchor: أي أدخل عليك مشقة في شيء من ذلك ولا غيره

BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r16.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r16.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r16.claim: The father qualifies his promise with God’s will, following pious self-watchfulness, and promises good companionship and faithful performance.
BIQAI-FULL:v5p478/r16.anchor: استثنى على قاعدة أولياء الله وأنبيائه في المراقبة

DURR-FULL:v6p404/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r2.claim: Asked which term Moses completed, Ibn Abbas answered that it was the more dutiful and fuller term.
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r2.anchor:
قيل لابن عباس رضي الله عنهما
أي الأجلين قضى موسى عليه السلام قال: أبرهما وأوفاهما

DURR-FULL:v6p404/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r3.speaker: عمر بن الخطاب
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r3.claim: Umar’s report recounts Moses lifting the stone and watering the flock, the daughter’s modest conduct and his propriety, and the father proposing marriage for eight years with an optional tenth; al-Hakim authenticated it.
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r3.anchor: عن عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه قال: أن موسى عليه السلام لما ورد ماء مدين وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون

DURR-FULL:v6p404/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r4.speaker: author
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r4.claim: Being among the righteous here means good companionship and keeping the promise made.
DURR-FULL:v6p404/r4.anchor: أي في حسن الصحبة والوفاء بما قلت قال موسى عليه السلام

DURR-FULL:v6p407/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r4.claim: Ibn Abbas says Moses’ father-in-law was named Yathribi.

DURR-FULL:v6p407/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r5.claim: Another report from Ibn Abbas calls the man who hired Moses Yathrib, the master of Midian.
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r5.anchor: الذي استأجر موسى عليه السلام يثرب صاحب مدين

DURR-FULL:v6p407/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r6.claim: Ibn Abbas disliked the kunya Abu Murra, Pharaoh’s kunya, and names Moses’ wife Safira, daughter of Yathrun.
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r6.anchor: أنه كان يكره الكنية بأبي مرة وكانت كنية فرعون وكانت صاحبة موسى صفيرا بنت يثرون

DURR-FULL:v6p407/r9.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r9.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r9.claim: Ibn Jurayj says Moses married the elder daughter who invited him, named Safura; he gives her father’s names as Raawil and, in the scripture, Yathrun, explaining that a kahin is a learned religious authority.
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r9.anchor: بلغني أنه نكح الكبيرة التي دعته واسمها صفورا وأبوها ابن أخي شعيب

DURR-FULL:v6p407/r10.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r10.speaker: نوف الشامي
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r10.claim: Nawf al-Shami says Moses’ wife bore a son whom Moses named Jarthama.
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r10.anchor: ولدت المرأة لموسى عليه السلام غلاما فسماه جرثمة

DURR-FULL:v6p407/r11.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r11.speaker: عقبة بن المنذر السلمي
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r11.claim: Uqba reports the Prophet saying Moses hired himself for eight or ten years to preserve chastity and obtain food; when leaving, he received a flock, used his staff at the watering place, and its sheep multiplied into many colors.
DURR-FULL:v6p407/r11.anchor: كنا عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقرأ {طس} حتى بلغ قصة موسى عليه السلام

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r1.speaker: author
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r1.claim: The source states that Moses completed the fuller and better term: ten years.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r1.anchor: أن موسى قضى أتم الأجلين وأطيبه عشر سنين

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r2.speaker: جابر
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r2.claim: Jabir reports that the Prophet answered that Moses completed the more fully fulfilled of the two terms.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r2.anchor: عن جابر رضي الله عنه قال: سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أي الأجلين قضى موسى قال: أوفاهما

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r3.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r3.speaker: أبو هريرة
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r3.claim: Abu Hurayra reports the Prophet relaying Gabriel’s instruction: answer that Moses completed the fuller term and married the younger daughter.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r3.anchor: عن أبي هريرة قال قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال لي جبريل: يا محمد إن سألك اليهود أي الأجلين قضى موسى

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r4.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r4.speaker: أبو ذر
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r4.claim: Abu Dharr reports the Prophet instructing that Moses fulfilled the better, more dutiful term and married the younger daughter, who had invited him; she cites his lifting a heavy stone and asking her to walk behind.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r4.anchor: عن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه قال قال لي رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: إذا سئلت أي الأجلين قضى موسى فقل خيرهما وأبرهما

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r5.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r5.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r5.claim: A report from Ibn Abbas quotes the Prophet saying Moses completed the longer and better term.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r5.anchor: عن ابن عباس رضي الله عنهما قال سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أي الأجلين قضى موسى قال: أبعدهما وأطيبهما

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r6.speaker: أبو ذر
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r6.claim: A weak-chain report from Abu Dharr says the Prophet answered that Moses completed the more dutiful and fuller term and married the younger daughter.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r6.anchor: بسند ضعيف عن أبي ذر رضي الله عنه أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل أي الأجلين قضى موسى قال: أبرهما وأوفاهما

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r7.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r7.speaker: محمد بن كعب القرظي
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r7.claim: Muhammad ibn Kab al-Qurazi reports the Prophet asking Gabriel, who asks Michael and Israfil before God answers: Moses fulfilled the more dutiful and fuller term.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r7.anchor: عن محمد بن كعب القرظي رضي الله عنه قال سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم أي الأجلين قضى موسى قال: سوف أسأل جبريل

DURR-FULL:v6p410/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r8.speaker: الحسن بن علي
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r8.claim: When Muqsim asked Hasan ibn Ali which term Moses completed, Hasan answered: the later one.
DURR-FULL:v6p410/r8.anchor: عن مقسم قال: لقيت الحسن بن علي بن أبي طالب رضي الله عنهما فقلت له: أي الأجلين قضى موسى

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r1.speaker: عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن اسلم
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r1.claim: In ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Zayd's account, Moses chose the daughter who had invited him, and her father assured him she was chaste before arranging the marriage.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r1.anchor: عبد الرحمن بن زيد بن اسلم ، في قول الله : اني اريد ان انكحك احدى ابنتي هاتين على ان تاجرني ثماني حجج

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r2.speaker: رسول الله
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r2.claim: The Prophet says Moses hired himself out to preserve his chastity and provide food for his stomach.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r2.anchor: صاحب رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - يحدث ان رسول الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - قال : ان موسى

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r3.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r3.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r3.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the eight years of service were obligatory for Moses.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r3.anchor: عن سعيد بن جبير ، عن ابن عباس ، فقال له : هل لك إلى ان انكحك احدى ابنتي هاتين على ان تاجرني ثماني حجج

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r4.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r4.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r4.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās says the remaining two years were voluntary; Moses completed ten, and Ibn ʿAbbās told Saʿīd that a prophet would not fall short of the obligatory eight and that God would fulfill the promised term.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2968#2/r4.anchor: فلقيت ابن عباس ، فذكرت ذلك له ، فقال : اما علمت ان ثمانيا كانت على نبي الله - صلى الله عليه وسلم - واجبة

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r1.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r1.speaker: محمد بن اسحاق
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r1.claim: Ibn Isḥāq says the father promises good companionship and keeping his word; Moses stayed with him, tending the sheep and meeting his needs.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r1.anchor: عن محمد بن اسحاق ، وما اريد ان اشق عليك ستجدني ان شاء الله من الصالحين اي في حسن الصحبة والوفاء بما قلت

IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r2.author: Ibn Abī Ḥātim al-Rāzī
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r2.speaker: محمد بن اسحاق
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r2.claim: Ibn Isḥāq names Moses' wife as Ṣaffūra, mentions her sister Sharfa, and identifies them as the two women who had held their flock back.
IBNABIHATIM:v9p2969/r2.anchor: عن محمد بن اسحاق ، وما اريد ان اشق عليك ستجدني ان شاء الله من الصالحين

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r1.claim: The preposition ʿalā is one of the forms used to state a contractual condition.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r1.anchor: حرف { على } من صيغ الشرط في العقود

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r2.claim: Taʾjurnī means to work for someone as a hired employee.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r2.anchor: و { تأجرني } مضارع آجره مثل نصره إذا كان أجيرا له

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r3.claim: Ḥijaj is the plural of ḥijja, a year; its name derives from pilgrimage, which occurs yearly near the end of the Arabic calendar year.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r3.anchor: والحجج : اسم جمع حجة بكسر الحاء وهي السنة ، مشتقة من اسم الحج

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r4.claim: The father proposes making marriage conditional on a hire contract; the proposal itself is neither a marriage nor a hire until Moses agrees, and it supports joining the two contracts.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r4.anchor: والتزام جعل تزويجه مشروطا بعقد الإجارة بينهما عرض منه على موسى وليس بعقد نكاح

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r5.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r5.claim: A Prophetic report tells of a woman who offered herself to the Prophet; he did not marry her but married her to a man present who lacked a dower, in exchange for teaching her what he knew of the Qur’an.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r5.anchor: حديث المرأة التي عرضت نفسها على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم فلم يتزوجها وزوجها من رجل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r6.speaker: مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r6.claim: The well-known Mālikī position voids a marriage condition that conflicts with marriage, annulling before consummation or confirming it afterward with the standard dower; a compatible condition is canceled without annulling the marriage.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r6.anchor: والمشهور من مذهب مالك أن الشرط المقارن لعقد النكاح إن كان مما ينافي عقد النكاح فهو باطل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r7.speaker: مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r7.claim: Another report from Mālik is that all conditions are initially disliked, but if made, they stand.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r7.anchor: وعن مالك أيضا : تكره الشروط كلها ابتداء فإن وقع مضى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r8.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r8.speaker: أشهب وأصبغ
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r8.claim: Ashhab and Aṣbagh allow the condition; Abū Bakr ibn al-ʿArabī selects their view, which Ibn ʿĀshūr prefers based on this verse and the Prophetic command to honor conditions made in marriage.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r8.anchor: وقال أشهب وأصبغ : الشرط جائز واختاره أبو بكر بن العربي وهو الحق للآية

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r9.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r9.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r9.claim: The apparent sense makes the hire the daughter’s dower; alternatively, it may require only the hire, with the dower governed by their own law, since legal definitions can differ across revealed laws.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r9.anchor: وظاهر الآية أيضا أن الإجارة المذكورة جعلت مهرا للبنت . ويحتمل أن المشروط التزام الإجارة لا غير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r10.claim: If the apparent reading is right, the dower was the benefit of Moses’s work for Shuʿayb; the daughter may have consented by hearing and remaining silent under their custom, or the father may have been entitled to the dower under their law.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r10.anchor: وإذا أخذنا بظاهر الآية كانت دالة على أنهما جعلا المهر منافع إجارة الزوج لشعيب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r11.claim: Because the verse is ambiguous, it cannot alone prove that a woman’s dower may be her husband’s hired services; the issue should be tested against legal principles and the general meaning of dower, which can include valuable services.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p106/r11.anchor: وإذ قد كان في الآية إجمال لم تكن كافية في الاحتجاج على جواز جعل مهر المرأة منافع من إجارة زوجها

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r1.claim: Exodus says Moses tended Jethro’s sheep, but the Qur’an has no purpose in specifying that work.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r1.anchor: وورد في سفر الخروج أنه رعى غنم يثرون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r2.claim: The verse does not specify wages; on its apparent reading, the payment is marriage to the daughter, while otherwise customary tribal wages are left unstated because the story has no need to detail them.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r2.anchor: وقد علمت أن الظاهر أنه إنكاحه البنت فإذا لم نأخذ بهذا الظاهر كانت الآية غير متعرضة للأجر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r3.claim: The author recalls that shepherds in the early 14th century received an annual shirt, shoes called balagha, and other items as customary compensation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r3.anchor: أن راعي الغنم له في كل عام قميص وحذاء يسمى

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r4.claim: The extra two years are left to Moses as a favor, according to his inclination when the eight-year term ends.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r4.anchor: جعل ذلك إلى موسى تفضلا منه أن اختاره ووكله إلى ما تكون عليه حاله

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r5.claim: Min is partitive in origin, and ʿinda is figuratively the self; the omitted predicate means completion of ten is from Moses, not the employer, so it is outside the bilateral contract.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r5.anchor: و ( من ) ابتدائية . و ( عند ) مستعملة في الذات والنفس مجازا

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r6.speaker: مالك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r6.claim: Malik cites the father’s offer without a reported request for the daughter’s consent as evidence that a father may marry off his virgin daughter without her permission.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r6.anchor: واحتج مالك بقوله { إني أريد أن أنكحك إحدى ابنتي هاتين } على أن للأب إنكاح ابنته البكر

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r7.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r7.speaker: من يمنع ذلك
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r7.claim: Opponents answer that the verse’s silence about seeking permission does not prove that permission was not obtained.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p108/r7.anchor: ولمن يمنع ذلك أن يقول : إن عدم التعرض له لا يقتضي عدم وقوعه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r1.claim: Shuʿayb means he will be righteous in dealing with people through good treatment and gentleness, thereby showing Moses his character.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r1.anchor: يريد الصالحين بالناس في حسن المعاملة ولين الجانب

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r2.claim: This self-description is not forbidden self-praise: praise is blameworthy when intended for boasting, whereas a religious or practical purpose is a good motive, as in Joseph’s request at 12:55.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r2.anchor: ليس هذا من تزكية النفس المنهي عنه لأن المنهي عنه ما قصد به قائله الفخر والتمدح

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r3.claim: Ashuq means to impose hardship; attributing the hardship to the speaker is figurative because he would be its cause, meaning he will not stipulate a burdensome condition.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r3.anchor: أكون شاقا عليك ، أي مكلفك مشقة ، والمشقة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r4.claim: The assurance of leniency accords with the hadith praising a person who is gracious when selling and buying; no grading is stated.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v20p109/r4.anchor: وهذا من السماحة الوارد فيها حديث : ( رحم الله امرأ سمحا إذا باع

BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r1.claim: If Moses completes ten years, that extra service is a voluntary favor from him, not an obligation imposed by Shuayb.

BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r2.claim: Shuayb does not want to burden Moses with the full ten years or exhausting work; hardship comes from what divides one's judgment and effort.
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r2.anchor: واشتقاق المشقة من الشق فإن ما يصعب عليك بشق اعتقادك في إطاقته ويوزع رأيك في مزاولته

BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r3.speaker: بعض العرفاء
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r3.claim: Some knowers say Shuayb foresaw Moses would reach completion and need no more spiritual training after eight years, with perfection of perfection at ten and independence beyond striving.
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r3.anchor: قال بعض العرفاء : رأى شعيب بنور النبوة أنه يبلغ إلى درجة الكمال في ثماني حجج ولا يحتاج إلى التربية بعد ذلك

BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r4.claim: The interpretation implies Moses was thirty when he made the agreement, returned after ten years, and was commissioned on the road; the author relates this to completion of the path of annihilation and subsistence.
BURSEVI:v6p289#2/r4.anchor: يقول الفقير : اقتضى هذا التأويل أن عمر موسى وقتئذ كان ثلاثين

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r1.claim: Shuayb's righteousness here means good treatment, gentleness, and keeping his covenant.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r1.anchor: في حسن المعاملة ولين الجانب والوفاء بالعهد

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r2.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r2.claim: The qualification God willing is for blessing and entrusting the matter to God's enabling grace, not making Shuayb's righteousness conditional.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r2.anchor: ومراده بالاستثناء التبرك به وتفويض الأمر إلى توفيقه لا تعليق صلاحه بمشيئته تعالى

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r3.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r3.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r3.claim: A report says Shuayb wept from love of God until blind; asked whether from longing for Paradise or fear of Hell, he answered that he loved God and did not care what God did, and God promised him the joy of meeting and gave him Moses to serve.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r3.anchor: وفي الحديث : "بكى شعيب النبي عليه السلام من حب الله حتى عمي فرد الله عليه بصره وأوحى الله إليه

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r4.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r4.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r4.claim: Moses' flight from Pharaoh to Shuayb signifies a seeker's move from the commanding soul to the heart, away from an evil companion toward a good guide, whom he serves sincerely and steadily.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r4.anchor: اعلم أن في فرار موسى من فرعون إلى شعيب إشارة إلى أنه ينبغي لطالب الحق أن يسافر من مقام النفس الأمارة

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r5.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r5.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r5.claim: Ibrahim ibn Adham is reported to have carried wood for seventeen years.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r5.anchor: روي : أن إبراهيم بن أدهم كان يحمل الحطب سبع عشرة سنة

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r6.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r6.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r6.claim: The service agreement alludes to the Sufi path: having disciples serve their spiritual guides follows the practice of prophets.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r6.anchor: وفي قوله : {على أن تأجرنى ثمانى حجج} إشارة إلى طريق الصوفية وأن استخدامهم للمريدين من سنن الأنبياء

BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r7.claim: The Hafiz couplet pictures one attaining the goal only after years serving Shuayb devotedly.
BURSEVI:v6p289#3/r7.anchor: قال الحافظ : شبان وادي أيمن كهي رسد بمراد كه ند سال بجان خدمت شعيب كند

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r2.speaker: الرواة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r2.claim: Reports name the women Liya and Sharafa, and Moses' wife Safura or Suriya.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r2.anchor: وروي أن اسم إحداهما ليا والأخرى شرفا، وروي أن اسم زوجة موسى منهما صفورة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r3.speaker: وهب
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r3.claim: Wahb says Moses married the elder daughter.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r3.anchor: وقال وهب: زوجه الكبرى، وروي عن النبي

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r4.speaker: النبي عليه السلام
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r4.claim: A report attributed to the Prophet says Moses married the younger daughter; al-Thaʿlabi and Makki transmit it through Abu Dharr.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r4.anchor: وروي عن النبي عليه السلام أنه زوجه الصغرى، وذكره الثعلبي ومكي من طريق أبي ذر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r9.speaker: الجمهور
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r9.claim: The majority identify the inviter and prospective father-in-law as Shuayb, with the women as his daughters.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r9.anchor: واختلف الناس في الرجل الداعي لموسى عليه السلام من هو، فقال الجمهور هو شعيب عليه السلام وهما ابنتاه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r10.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r10.speaker: الحسن وأبو عبيدة
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r10.claim: Hasan says the man was Shuayb's nephew, named Tharwan; Abu Ubayda gives the name Yathrun.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r10.anchor: وقال الحسن: هو ابن أخي شعيب واسمه ثروان، وقال أبو عبيدة: يثرون

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r11.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r11.speaker: قيل
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r11.claim: Others say he was a righteous man unrelated to Shuayb; another account makes their uncle the sender and groom, called father because he stood in that place.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#2/r11.anchor: وقيل هو رجل صالح ليس من شعيب بنسب، وقيل إن المرأتين إنما كان مرسلهما عمهما

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas says the father married Moses to the daughter who had invited him.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r2.anchor: قال ابن عباس فزوجه التي دعته

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r3.speaker: مكي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r3.claim: Makki explains تأجرني as reward or pay me.

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r4.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r4.speaker: مكي
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r4.claim: Makki lists the bride as unspecified, the initial term unfixed, the dowry as hired service, and consummation before payment as features of the episode.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r4.anchor: وقال مكي في هذه الآية خصائص في النكاح منها أنه لم يعين الزوجة ولا حد أول الأمر

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r5.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r5.speaker: القاضي أبو محمد
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r5.claim: Ibn Atiyya says the bride was likely specified during negotiation; the term's start is unstated and runs from the contract if unassigned, while marriage for service is explicit.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r5.anchor: قال القاضي أبو محمد: أما التعيين فيشبه أنه كان في أثناء حال المراوضة وإنما عرض الأمر مجملا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r6.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r6.claim: Marriage for service is affirmed in Islamic law and illustrated by the hadith of a man who had only some Qur'an; some scholars restrict it or consider it abrogated.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r6.anchor: وهذا أمر قد قرره شرعنا وجرى به في حديث الذي لم يكن عنده إلا شيء من القرآن

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r7.speaker: مالك وابن حبيب وغيره
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r7.claim: Malik disallows marriage for service; Ibn Habib and others allow it if payment reaches the wife beforehand.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r7.anchor: ولم يجوز مالك رحمه الله النكاح بالإجارة، وجوزها ابن حبيب وغيره إذا كانت الأجرة تصل إلى الزوجة

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r8.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r8.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r8.claim: The objection that Shuayb's phrasing should be أنكحه إياها rather than أنكحها إياه is unfounded.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r8.anchor: ومن لفظ شعيب عليه السلام حسن في لفظ العقود في النكاح، أنكحه إياها أكثر من أنكحها إياه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r9.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r9.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r9.claim: Shuayb made eight years the condition and left two more to Moses' generosity.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v4p284#3/r9.anchor: وجعل شعيب «الثمانية الأعوام» شرطا ووكل العامين إلى المروءة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r1.claim: Shuʿayb was drawn to Moses and proposed marriage to one of his two daughters in return for service.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r1.anchor: قال المفسرون فرغب فيه شعيب فقال له إني أريد أن أنكحك أي أزواجك إحدى ابنتي هاتين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r2.speaker: الفراء
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r2.claim: Al-Farrāʾ reports two vocalizations of taʾjurnī, with ḍamma or kasra on the jīm; both are Arabic forms.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r2.anchor: قال الفراء تأجرني وتأجرني بضم الجيم وكسرها لغتان

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r3.speaker: الزجاج
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r3.claim: Al-Zajjāj explains the bargain as Moses working for him as a hired laborer for eight years.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r3.anchor: قال الزجاج والمعنى تكون أجيرا لي ثماني سنين

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r4.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r4.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r4.claim: Completing ten years would be a voluntary favor from Moses, not an obligation.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r4.anchor: أي فذلك تفضل منك وليس بواجب عليك

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r5.claim: Shuʿayb means that he does not intend to burden Moses over the full ten years.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r5.anchor: ﴿ وما أريد أن أشق عليك ﴾ أي في العشر

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r6.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r6.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r6.claim: Shuʿayb promises good companionship and fulfillment of what he has said.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v6p215#2/r6.anchor: أي في حسن الصحبة والوفاء بما قلت

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r1.speaker: أبو عبيدة بن عبد الله بن مسعود
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r1.claim: Abu Ubayda ibn Abdullah ibn Masud identifies the man in the story as Athrun, a nephew of Shuaib.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r1.anchor: وقال أبو عبيدة بن عبد الله بن مسعود: وأثرون (3) وهو ابن أخي شعيب

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r2.claim: Ibn Abbas, through Abu Hamza, identifies the person who hired Moses as Yathra, the owner of Midian.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r2.anchor: وعن أبي حمزة (4) عن ابن عباس: الذي استأجر موسى يثرى صاحب مدين

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r3.speaker: ابن جرير
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r3.claim: Al-Tabari says the father’s identity cannot be established except through a transmitted report, and no report here provides proof compelling acceptance.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r3.anchor: ثم قال: الصواب أن هذا لا يدرك إلا بخبر، ولا خبر تجب به الحجة في ذلك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r7.claim: The elderly father proposed that Moses tend his sheep and marry one of his two daughters.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r7.anchor: قاال: {إني أريد أن أنكحك إحدى ابنتي هاتين}

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r8.speaker: شعيب الجبائي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r8.claim: Shuaib al-Jubba'i names the daughters Safura and Layya.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r8.anchor: قال شعيب الجبائي: وهما صفورا، وليا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r9.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r9.speaker: محمد بن إسحاق
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r9.claim: Muhammad ibn Ishaq gives their names as Safura and Sharqa, with Layya also reported as a name.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r9.anchor: وقال محمد بن إسحاق: صفورا وشرقا، ويقال: ليا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r10.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r10.speaker: أصحاب أبي حنيفة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r10.claim: Hanafi jurists infer that a sale is valid if someone offers one of two enslaved people for one hundred and the buyer accepts.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p229/r10.anchor: وقد استدل أصحاب أبي حنيفة [رحمه الله تعالى] (10) بهذه الآية على صحة البيع

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r1.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r1.claim: Moses was to serve eight years; two additional years would be voluntary, and eight were sufficient for the father.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r1.anchor: أي: على أن ترعى علي ثماني سنين، فإن تبرعت بزيادة سنتين فهو إليك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r2.claim: The father promises not to burden, harm, or argue with Moses.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r2.anchor: أي: لا أشاقك، ولا أؤاذيك، ولا أماريك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r3.speaker: الأوزاعي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r3.claim: Al-Awzai’s school permits an offer of ten in cash or twenty deferred, with the buyer choosing either price; they interpret the two-sales hadith to support this.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r3.anchor: وقد استدلوا بهذه الآية الكريمة لمذهب الأوزاعي

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r4.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r4.claim: Ibn Kathir considers the inference from this verse and the hadith for al-Awzai’s sale ruling open to scrutiny, and leaves its lengthy discussion aside.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r4.anchor: وفي الاستدلال بهذه الآية وهذا الحديث على هذا المذهب نظر، ليس هذا موضع بسطه لطوله

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r5.speaker: أصحاب الإمام أحمد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r5.claim: Ahmad’s followers and those who agree with them infer that hiring a worker in return for food and clothing is valid.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r5.anchor: ثم قد استدل أصحاب الإمام أحمد ومن تبعهم، في صحة (3) استئجار الأجير بالطعمة والكسوة بهذه الآية

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r6.speaker: عتبة بن الندر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r6.claim: Ibn Majah transmits from Utba ibn al-Nadr that Moses hired himself for eight or ten years in return for chastity and food; Ibn Kathir calls this route weak because Maslama ibn Ali was a weak transmitter.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r6.anchor: سمعت (5) عتبة بن الندر (6) يقول: كنا عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم فقرأ

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r7.speaker: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r7.claim: Ibn Abi Hatim transmits another report from Utba ibn al-Nadr that Moses hired himself for chastity and food; Ibn Kathir says this alternate route also warrants scrutiny.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p230/r7.anchor: يحدث أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: "إن موسى آجر نفسه بعفة فرجه، وطعمة بطنه"

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r1.speaker: يوسف بن تيرح
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r1.claim: A mursal report says the Prophet, Gabriel, and a higher angel did not know which term Moses fulfilled; God answered that he fulfilled the more wholesome, or purest, term.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r1.anchor: عن يوسف بن تيرح: أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل: أي الأجلين قضى موسى؟ قال: "لا علم لي".

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r2.speaker: مجاهد
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r2.claim: Mujahid relates a mursal report in which the Prophet asks Gabriel, Gabriel asks Israfil, and God answers that Moses fulfilled the more wholesome and complete term.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r2.anchor: قال مجاهد: إن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سأل جبريل:

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r3.speaker: محمد بن كعب القرظي
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r3.claim: In another mursal report, Muhammad ibn Kaʿb says the Prophet answered that Moses fulfilled the fuller and most complete term.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r3.anchor: عن محمد بن كعب القرظي قال: سئل رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r4.speaker: أبو ذر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r4.claim: Abu Dharr reports that the Prophet said Moses fulfilled the fuller and more righteous term and married the younger of Shuʿayb’s two daughters.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r4.anchor: عن أبي ذر: أن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل: أي الأجلين قضى موسى؟ قال: "أوفاهما وأبرهما"، قال: "وإن سئلت أي المرأتين تزوج؟ فقل الصغرى منهما".

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r5.claim: Ibn Kathir regards the several mursal reports as mutually reinforcing, then notes a marfuʿ version through Abu Dharr.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p231/r5.anchor: فهذه طرق متعاضدة، ثم قد (6) روي [هذا] (7) مرفوعا من رواية أبي ذر، رضي الله عنه،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r1.speaker: البزار
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r1.claim: Al-Bazzar says the Abu Dharr report is known only through this chain.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r1.anchor: ثم قال البزار: لا نعلم يروى عن أبي ذر إلا بهذا الإسناد (8) .

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r2.speaker: عتبة بن الندر
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r2.claim: ʿUtba’s report says Moses worked for chastity and food; when he left Shuʿayb, his wife requested sheep for their livelihood, and a staff miracle produced variegated offspring, often twins or triplets, with a prediction of Samaritan sheep remaining in Syria.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r2.anchor: عن علي بن رباح اللخمي قال: سمعت عتبة بن الندر (10) يقول: إن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم سئل: أي الأجلين قضى موسى؟ قال

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r3.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r3.claim: Ibn Abi Hatim transmits a similar Utba report through ʿUbayd ibn Abi ʿImran, whom Ibn Kathir calls weak; its unusual addition tells of the flock miracle and Samaritan remnants.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p232/r3.anchor: وقد رواه ابن أبي حاتم من حديث عوبد بن أبي عمران -وهو ضعيف -ثم قد روي أيضا نحوه من حديث عتبة بن الندر (9) بزيادة غريبة جدا

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r1.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r1.speaker: ابن لهيعة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r1.claim: Ibn Lahīʿa defines al-fushūsh as a sheep that leaks milk widely and has a large flow.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r1.anchor: ابن لهيعة: ما الفشوش؟ قال: التي تفش بلبنها واسعة الشخب.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r2.speaker: ابن لهيعة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r2.claim: Ibn Lahīʿa defines al-ḍabūb as a sheep with a long udder that drags along.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r2.anchor: قلت: فما الضبوب؟ قال: الطويلة الضرع تجره.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r3.speaker: ابن لهيعة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r3.claim: Ibn Lahīʿa defines al-ʿazūz as a sheep with a narrow milk flow.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r3.anchor: قلت: فما العزوز؟ قال: ضيقة الشخب.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r4.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r4.speaker: ابن لهيعة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r4.claim: Ibn Lahīʿa defines al-thaʿūl as a sheep with no udder beyond something like two teats.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r4.anchor: قال فما الثعول؟ قال: التي ليس لها ضرع إلا كهيئة حلمتين.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r5.speaker: ابن لهيعة
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r5.claim: Ibn Lahīʿa defines al-kumaysha as one whose small udder is too small to grasp in the hand.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r5.anchor: قلت: فما الكميشة؟ قال: التي تفوت الكف، كميشة الضرع، صغير لا يدركه الكف.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r6.claim: The report rests on ʿAbd Allah ibn Lahīʿa, whose retention was poor, so Ibn Kathir fears the report was mistakenly raised to the Prophet.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r6.anchor: مدار هذا الحديث على عبد الله بن لهيعة المصري -وفي حفظه سوء -وأخشى أن يكون رفعه خطأ، والله أعلم.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r7.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r7.claim: Ibn Kathir says the wording should list the deficient sheep types as absent, including fushūsh, ʿazūz, ḍabūb, thaʿūl, and kumaysha.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r7.anchor: ليس فيها فشوش ولا عزوز، ولا ضبوب ولا ثعول

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r8.speaker: أنس بن مالك
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r8.claim: Anas, in a report Ibn Kathir calls well-chained, says Shuʿayb offered Moses any lambs born unlike their mothers; startled by ropes raised over the water, the flock bore variegated young except one sheep, whose offspring Moses took that year.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v6p233/r8.anchor: عن قتادة، حدثنا أنس بن مالك، رضي الله عنه، قال: لما دعا نبي الله موسى، عليه السلام، صاحبه إلى الأجل الذي كان بينهما

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r4.claim: A report says Shuayb married Moses to Safra.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r5.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r5.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r5.claim: The demonstrative 'these two' indicates that Shuayb had other daughters as well.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r5.anchor: وقوله : { هاتين } فيه دليل على أنه كانت له غيرهما { تأجرنى }

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r6.claim: تأجرني can mean that you work for me, or that I give you a specified compensation.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r6.anchor: { تأجرنى } من أجرته إذا كنت له أجيرا ، كقولك : أبوته إذا كنت له أبا

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r7.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r7.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r7.claim: ثماني حجج can be parsed as a time adverbial or as an object, with shepherding understood as work for eight seasons.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r7.anchor: و { ثمانى حجج } ظرفه . أو من أجرته كذا ، إذا أثبته إياه .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r8.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r8.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r8.claim: A prophetic condolence formula cited with the compensation sense says, 'May God reward you and show you mercy.'
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r8.anchor: ومنه : تعزية رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : ( 812 ) ( أجركم الله ورحمكم )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r9.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r9.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r9.claim: Shuaib's words were a proposal and description of an intention, not a marriage contract; a contract would say 'I have married you.'
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r9.anchor: لم يكن ذلك عقدا للنكاح ، ولكن مواعدة ومواصفة أمر قد عزم عليه ، ولو كان عقدا لقال : قد أنكحتك

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r10.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r10.speaker: أبو حنيفة
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r10.claim: Abu Hanifa disallows marriage in exchange for the husband serving his wife, since the husband is not property, but permits service by a slave or use of a house as property.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r10.anchor: ألا ترى إلى أبي حنيفة كيف منع أن يتزوج امرأة بأن يخدمها سنة وجوز أن يتزوجها بأن يخدمها عبده سنة

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r11.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r11.speaker: الشافعي
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r11.claim: Al-Shafii permits marriage in exchange for a specified service or work.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r11.anchor: وأما الشافعي : فقد جوز التزوج على الإجارة لبعض الأعمال والخدمة ، إذا كان المستأجر له أو المخدوم فيه أمرا معلوما

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r12.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r12.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r12.claim: Zamakhshari offers alternatives: the arrangement may have been lawful under Shuayb's dispensation, the dowry may have been separate, or shepherding and marriage may have been linked as a pact rather than a contract.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r12.anchor: ولعل ذلك كان جائزا في تلك الشريعة . ويجوز أن يكون المهر شيئا آخر ، وإنما أراد أن يكون راعي غنمه

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r13.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r13.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r13.claim: A further possibility is that Moses was hired for eight years at a known wage, paid, and then married to the daughter with the wage as dowry; the phrase summarizes their agreement.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r13.anchor: ويجوز أن يستأجره لرعية ثماني سنين بمبلغ معلوم ويوفيه إياه ، ثم ينكحه ابنته به

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r14.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r14.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r14.claim: If Moses completes ten years, the extra two are a voluntary favor from him, not an obligation imposed by Shuayb.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r15.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r15.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r15.claim: Shuayb will not force Moses to complete the longer term; more broadly, he promises not to overburden him as hard employers do by nitpicking time and work.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r15.anchor: { وما أريد أن أشق عليك } بإلزام أتم الأجلين وإيجابه .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r16.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r16.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r16.claim: The image of hardship is that a daunting task seems to split one's judgment between thinking it bearable and unbearable.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r16.anchor: حقيقته أن الأمر إذا تعاظمك فكأنه شق عليك ظنك باثنين ، تقول تارة : أطيقه ، وتارة : لا أطيقه .

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r17.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r17.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r17.claim: Shuayb also promises lenient treatment and no unreasonable scrutiny or extra duties; prophets choose the gentlest course in people's dealings.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p407/r17.anchor: ولا يفعل نحو ما يفعل المعاسرون من المسترعين ، من المناقشة في مراعاة الأوقات

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r1.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r1.speaker: رسول الله
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r1.claim: A prophetic report says, 'He was my partner, and a good partner: he did not evade, haggle, or argue,' illustrating fair partnership.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r1.anchor: ( 813 ) ( كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم شريكي ، فكان خير شريك لا يداري ولا يشاري ولا يماري )

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r2.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r2.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r2.claim: الصالحين may mean good conduct, agreeable character, and gentleness, or righteousness in general, which includes good dealings.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r2.anchor: يريد بالصلاح : حسن المعاملة ووطأة الخلق ولين الجانب . ويجوز أن يريد الصلاح على العموم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r3.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r3.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r3.claim: Mentioning God's will expresses reliance on His guidance and help, not uncertainty about whether Shuayb will behave well.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v3p409/r3.anchor: والمراد باشتراط مشيئة الله بما وعد من الصلاح : الاتكال على توفيقه فيه ومعونته

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p247/r9.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p247/r9.speaker: author
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p247/r9.claim: The daughter who invited Moses and whom he married was named Safuriya; the other is named Layya by Ibn Ishaq or Sharafa by Ibn Jarir.
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p247/r9.anchor: وكان اسم التي دعت موسى وتزوجها : صفوريا

MAWARDI-FULL:v4p247/r18.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v4p247/r18.speaker: عبد الرحمن بن زيد
